warnings: Schematic level sections (no member rebar except the ledge detail). No printed mark names the two sections, so each is a section_view entry with element_id null and its title in element_name_assigned (precedent: house 170 S-10). Member specs stay on S-10..S-14; this sheet is not a spec source for B7/B8/B10/B11/R6.

Template wording kept verbatim: the title says 'ห้องเรียน' (classroom) and the room label 'พื้นห้อง' has its next word whited out on the scan - this office building reuses the สพฐ. school-building level sheet. Not corrected.

view2 prints B10 at both outer supports of the stair-hall cut, but the S-03 plan draws B10 only on C-D at grids 3/4/9/10 and B9 on grids 2/5/8/11. The cut (4.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 centre-to-centre, stair hall in the middle bay) can only be grids 2-5 or 8-11, where S-03 has B9 - so the 'B10' labels on this schematic disagree with the plan. Kept as printed; the plan (S-03) governs member positions (op01 precedence 2: the plan places members, the section only specifies them). Risk: none for quantities, this file carries no spec.

view1 is cut along the y axis through a stair-bay grid line (3/4/9/10): the 2.50 bay at the left is the C-D corridor where B10 is seen in elevation as 'คานหลัก B10'; the right-hand 'คานหลัก' is the A-C beam (B7/B8 there per S-03). Orientation is not printed; read from the 2.50 corridor bay.

Precast plank thickness printed 0.10 m here ('พื้นสำเร็จรูปหนา 0.10ม.วางพาดหลังคานหลัก', twice); the S-02 HC note reads '0.80-0.10 m.' (= 0.08-0.10). Topping 'คอนกรีตทับหน้าพื้นสำเร็จรูปหนา 5 ซม.'. Both kept as printed.

Ledge detail: 'ø' = RB (spec section 6). The detail gives only the ledge bars, not the beam's own main bars or stirrups, so it is recorded as one connection_detail entry (element_id null, applies_to B7/B8/B11) instead of three beam specs - writing B7/B8/B11 here would shadow their real S-12/S-13 specs in the spec join. Same ledge (0.15 / ø9mm@0.15m. / 2-ø6mm) is printed beside G6 on S-10.

Sheet box 'เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อย ทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40' (same wording as S-05). Dimension rows on this sheet go to the grid master (y 1.50 | 10.50 | 1.50 and 2.50; x 4.00 | 4.00 | 4.00); member-internal sizes (0.70 beam depth, 0.05 / 0.10 steps, 0.60 plank width, 0.15 ledge) are kept on the elements below.
